lead: Four options for every budget in the heart of the city, a few steps from the Cathedral, the Mercado Central and the Lonja de la Seda.

Accommodation in the Centro covers every profile: from the luxury boutique hotel with a rooftop next to the Cathedral to the classic renovated hostal on the main square itself, by way of an international chain hotel with historic views and a modern three-star on a pedestrian street. All four share Valencia’s most valuable advantage: being within walking distance of everything.

The pedestrian area surrounding the Plaza del Ayuntamiento — the streets Convento Santa Clara, San Vicente and the Xàtiva area — offers a human-scale city experience, with no need for a car for any cultural or gastronomic visit in the historic centre.

items.title: Meliá Plaza Valencia
items.subtitle: Classic building · Views of the Plaza del Ayuntamiento · Rooftop solarium terrace · Gym and sauna
items.body: The Meliá Plaza Valencia occupies a grand classic building right on the Plaza del Ayuntamiento, the heart of Valencia. With 101 rooms spread over 11 floors, it offers the perfect combination of history and modern comfort: wooden or ceramic floors, made-to-measure mattresses, minibar, safe and flat-screen TV. Some rooms have a private terrace with direct views of the square, ideal for soaking up the Valencian atmosphere. The rooftop solarium terrace, the gym and the sauna complete a high-level offer that makes it one of the benchmark accommodations of the historic centre. The hotel restaurant and the Barecito bar serve homemade tapas and pintxos. Valencia-Norte railway station is just a 5-minute walk away, and the Cathedral 10.

items.title: The Valentia Cabillers
items.subtitle: 50 m from the Cathedral · Contemporary design · Rooftop with pool · Renovated landmark building
items.body: The Valentia Cabillers is the most distinctive luxury boutique hotel in the old town. It occupies a landmark building completely renovated on Calle Cabillers, just 50 metres from Valencia Cathedral and the Miguelete, and a few steps from the Mercado Central and the Church of Santa Catalina. Its interior design is sober and contemporary, with bright suites, rooms with open kitchens and terraces or balconies. The rooftop has an outdoor pool and spectacular views of the centre of Valencia, making it a unique experience in the city. It belongs to The Valentia Hoteles collection, which defines its philosophy as “turning the most authentic Valencia into design retreats”. An ideal option for those seeking an immersive stay in historic Valencia without giving up boutique luxury.

items.title: Hostal Venecia Plaza Centro
items.subtitle: Value for money · Views of the Plaza del Ayuntamiento · Rooms with balcony · Without leaving the centre
items.body: The Hostal Venecia Plaza Centro is the most recommended option for travellers seeking the best location with exceptional value for money. Located right on the Plaza del Ayuntamiento — number 3 —, it occupies a lovely classic building completely renovated with 87 rooms equipped with air conditioning, WiFi, flat-screen TV and safe. Some rooms have a balcony with direct views of Valencia’s main square. The daily breakfast buffet and the common TV room complete the offer. From the hostal door you can walk to the Cathedral in under 10 minutes, to the Lonja de la Seda in 5, and to the Xàtiva metro station in 5 minutes, with a direct connection to the airport. An unbeatable option for getting to know the historic centre on foot.

items.title: Hotel RH Sorolla Centro
items.subtitle: Pedestrian area · 50 m from the Plaza del Ayuntamiento · Free WiFi and safe · Welcome bottle of wine
items.body: The Hotel RH Sorolla Centro is a modern 3-star property in the most commercial pedestrian area of central Valencia, just 50 metres from the Plaza del Ayuntamiento. Its 58 contemporary rooms are equipped with air conditioning, LCD TV with international channels, free WiFi and a safe. Rooms with a balcony or private terrace offer views of the lively pedestrian streets of the centre. The buffet breakfast is served from 7:30 to 11:00 and reception is open 24 hours. One distinguishing detail: those who book directly on the official website receive a welcome bottle of wine. The Xàtiva metro station — with a direct connection to the airport — is less than 200 metres away, and the Valencia-Norte railway station 200 metres. Bike rental is available at the hotel.

blocks.title: Tips for staying in the Centro
items: For views of the square: request a room with a balcony at the Hostal Venecia or an exterior suite at the Meliá — the supplement is worth it
The Valentia Cabillers has the best rooftop in the centre: book in advance if you want to enjoy the pool in summer
The RH Sorolla Centro gives a bottle of wine when you book on its official website — always better than through Booking
During the March Fallas, book 3–6 months in advance: the centre fills up completely and prices multiply
The Xàtiva metro (200 m from the Sorolla and 5 min from the rest) takes you to the airport with no transfer in 20 minutes
All the hotels are in a restricted-traffic zone: arrange parking with the hotel before arriving by car
